💡 Action Plan & Recommendations
🔴 Urgent · Route 1 – Mobinil El Hosary
Route avg utilization ~78% — above the 75% congestion threshold. Kuwadico-Grand Heights alone at 85.6%. Request upgrade 20G → 30G immediately. Accelerate securing for Garden Hills (77.5%) & MV Chill Out Park (66.2%). Summer peak will push route beyond 90%.
🔴 High Priority · Route 2 – Ganoub El Mostathmreen
MIVIDA (76.6%), ETR (76.8%), Villete (73.8%) — combined load ~21 Gbps on a 20G link. Plan 30G upgrade before Q3 2026. Validate fiber backup on MIVIDA & ETR as active & load-bearing now.
🟡 Monitor · Route 3 – Tagamo El Khames
62–74% across all 4 secured sites. Adequate headroom on 27G today. Schedule Q4 2026 capacity review before any BW upgrades at Stone Park / 90 Avenue are planned.
🟢 Seasonal Prep · Route 4 – Ras El Hekma
Off-season at ~14% average. Before summer 2026: resolve Fuka Bay pending securing, finalize Swan Lake NC (In-Progress), commission Marakez Ramla TX. Peak can reach 60–70%; expand 5G if Emaar Soul activates.
🟡 Cross-Route · Redundancy & Failover
Routes 1 & 2 are both congested. Validate failover paths for MIVIDA, ETR, SODIC WEST. Confirm fiber directions on "2 MW + Fiber" sites are live and load-sharing. Redistribute Route 2 load to fiber where available.
🟡 Securing Pipeline · All Routes
10 sites remain "In-Progress" securing. Prioritize all sites ≥65% utilization — Garden Hills, MV Chill Out Park, Green 4 & 5, Concordia. Escalate Telal El Sokhna (Sharing Team blocked) immediately.

Orange Triple Play Services is an integrated telecommunications solution delivering high-speed internet, IP telephony, and digital television through a single broadband infrastructure. Leveraging cutting-edge technologies such as Fiber to the Home (FTTH) and microwave connectivity, the system ensures seamless, reliable, and high-quality service delivery.
